name: Adept
professional_skills: Disciplines (Attune or any known Metafocus Skill)
description: An adept is a person who has developed their skills and abilities to a high level in a particular area. This can be achieved through a combination of innate talent, training, and experience. Adepts may possess unique powers or abilities that set them apart from others in their field, making them valuable assets in various situations. These abilities could include mental abilities, arcane study, or some other source. Adepts are often sought after for their expertise and skills, and they can play a vital role in many different areas. For example, they may be used as consultants, trainers, or even soldiers. Adepts can be found in all walks of life, and they can use their skills for good or evil. Some adepts choose to use their powers to help others, while others use them for personal gain or to harm others. Adepts are often seen as mysterious and powerful figures, and they can be both feared and respected. Though many may have Awakened various Metafocus Skills and Abilities - an Adept has a true understanding of the arts.

name: Agent
professional_skills: Stealth and one Social or Vocation Skill
description: An agent is a skilled operative who specializes in espionage, intelligence gathering, and covert missions. They often work for governments, corporations, or other powerful organizations. Agents are typically highly trained in a variety of skills, including infiltration, surveillance, and interrogation. They may also be experts in foreign languages, cultures, and technologies. Agents often work in dangerous and high-pressure environments, and they must be able to think quickly and make sound decisions under pressure. They must also be able to maintain their cover identities and blend in with their surroundings. Agents play a vital role in gathering intelligence and carrying out covert operations. They can help to prevent terrorist attacks, protect national security, and advance the interests of their employers. Overall, agents are versatile and adaptable, making them valuable assets in any organization or team.

name: Builder
description: A builder character would be responsible for creating, repairing, and modifying various items, equipment, and structures. This character would have a diverse set of skills and knowledge in various fields, such as engineering, materials science, and technology. They would need to be able to understand and work with a variety of materials, and be able to design and build structures that are both functional and aesthetically pleasing. They would also need to be able to troubleshoot problems and make repairs when necessary. Builder characters are often essential to the success of any group or community. They can provide the tools and structures that are necessary for survival, and they can help to improve the quality of life for everyone.

name: Citizen
description: A Citizen is an individual living within a diverse and interconnected society, spanning multiple planets or star systems. They may have various roles and occupations, such as traders, workers, scientists, or artists, contributing to the overall functioning of their community. They are likely to be familiar with customs, languages, and technologies, allowing them to navigate the complexities of their society.

name: Criminal
professional_skills: Stealth and one Knowledge or Vocation
description: A Criminal is a character who engages in illegal activities for personal gain or as part of an organized group. This can include roles such as thieves, con artists, burglars, assassins, and members of criminal organizations. Criminal characters often possess skills in stealth, deception, and combat, allowing them to navigate the dangerous underworld and accomplish their objectives. Many Criminals can be quite brutish but some will be quite professional and honorable. Though others commit a myriad assortment of crimes on a regular basis, no one is as good at crime-for-profit as an actual Criminal.

name: Drifter
professional_skills: Survival and any three Knowledge or Vocation Skills
description: A drifter is a person who travels from place to place, often without a fixed home or occupation. They may take on various temporary jobs or roles to survive, and their lifestyle is typically characterized by freedom, adaptability, and a sense of adventure. Drifters may be motivated by a variety of factors, such as a desire to see the world, a need to escape from a difficult situation, or simply a love of travel. They may also be drawn to the drifter lifestyle because it offers them a sense of freedom and independence. While the drifter lifestyle can be challenging, it can also be very rewarding. Drifters often have the opportunity to meet new people, experience different cultures, and see amazing things. They may also develop a strong sense of self-reliance and independence. Drifters can be found in various settings, such as aboard starships, space stations, or on distant planets.

name: Entertainer
description: Entertainers might perform in various forms of art, such as music, dance, acting, or even virtual reality experiences. They could use advanced technology to create immersive and captivating performances, reaching audiences across different planets and star systems.Entertainers in the future may perform in a variety of ways, including music, dance, acting, and even virtual reality experiences. They can use advanced technology to create immersive and captivating performances that can reach audiences across different planets and star systems. The possibilities for entertainment are truly endless. As technology continues to evolve, so will the ways we can be entertained.

name: Merchant
description: A merchant's occupation would involve trading, negotiating, and exploring uncharted regions of space for profit and adventure. As a merchant, the character would be skilled in various aspects of commerce, diplomacy, and resource management. They would need to be able to assess the value of goods, negotiate prices, and manage their finances. They would also need to be able to build relationships with other merchants and traders, and be able to navigate the political and social landscape of the space they are in. Additionally, they would need to be able to handle the physical and mental challenges of exploring uncharted space, such as dealing with dangerous environments and creatures, and making quick decisions in high-pressure situations. They might operate a store, be a traveling merchant, or even a merchant prince, who is a powerful and wealthy individual with a license to explore and trade outside the limits of their civilization.

name: Representative
description: A Representative's occupation could involve diplomacy, negotiation, and communication between various factions, planets, or organizations. They might be responsible for maintaining relationships, resolving conflicts, and advocating for their constituents' interests whether they are in a governmental or corporate arena.   A Governmental Representative might be responsible for representing the interests of their constituents in the legislative branch of government. They would do this by drafting and voting on legislation, and by participating in committee hearings and floor debates. They would also be responsible for communicating with their constituents and keeping them updated on the legislative process.   A Corporate Representative might be responsible for representing the interests of their company in dealings with other companies, government agencies, and the public. They would do this by negotiating contracts, resolving disputes, and providing information about the company. They would also be responsible for communicating with the company's employees and keeping them updated on the company's activities.   Representatives play an important role in maintaining order and cooperation between different groups. They use their skills in diplomacy, negotiation, and communication to build relationships, resolve conflicts, and advocate for the interests of their constituents.

name: Scholar
description: A Scholar is a character who specializes in academic pursuits, research, and study. They possess a comprehensive education in a range of scientific skills.A scholar is a character who specializes in academic pursuits, research, and study. They possess a comprehensive education in a range of scientific skills. They are often well-read and have a deep understanding of various subjects. Scholars are typically curious and inquisitive, and they enjoy learning new things. They are also often creative and innovative, and they are able to think outside the box. Scholars can be found in a variety of settings, including universities, libraries, and research labs. Overall, scholars are intelligent, curious, and dedicated individuals who play an important role in society by advancing knowledge and understanding.

name: Scout
professional_skills: Survival and one Knowledge or Vocation Skill
description: A Scout focuses on exploration, survival, and gathering information in various environments. Scouts are often skilled in piloting, navigation, and engineering, and being adept at handling out-of-the-way locations and recognizing potential dangers. Scouts are trained to survey and survive in unknown territories, gathering information while keeping themselves safe. They are skilled in traversing different environments and are knowledgeable enough to make the most of their situation. Scouts are often proficient in finding food, shelter, and navigating through unfamiliar terrain.

name: Soldier
description: A Soldier can be described as a highly trained and versatile combatant, skilled in various forms of warfare and tactics. They are often responsible for protecting their allies, engaging in direct combat with enemies, and carrying out strategic operations.A soldier is a highly trained and versatile combatant, skilled in various forms of warfare and tactics. They are often responsible for protecting their allies, engaging in direct combat with enemies, and carrying out strategic operations. Soldiers must be able to think quickly and make decisions under pressure. They must also be able to work as part of a team and follow orders. Soldiers play a vital role in protecting the faction they serve and its citizens. They are often the first to respond to natural disasters and other emergencies. They also help keep the peace and protect their faction's borders. Soldiers are brave and dedicated individuals who put their lives on the line to serve their faction’s interest.

name: Specialist
professional_skills: Knowledge or Vocation Skills within specialized training
description: A Specialist focuses on a specific area of expertise, providing unique skills and abilities that make them valuable to their team in various situations. A specialist's expertise can range from technology and engineering to psychic powers and artistic expression. These characters often excel in their chosen field, allowing them to tackle challenges and solve problems that other characters might struggle with. Their specialized knowledge and skills can be crucial in overcoming obstacles, gathering information, or supporting the team in combat and non-combat situations.
